'''The Puddle''' was a small dirty oasis that was the source of [[Water/Legends|water]] for the settlement also known as [[The Puddle]]. Local residents said it tasted like [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] sweat and would cause sickness if the water was not properly treated and processed.<ref name="H&S" />
